1. Zoom Slides

Tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
Description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

3. readywhen

Tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
Description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you’d email a good assistant. It writes the follow-up, sends it from your email when you reply “send”, then watches for the answer. Ask what you’re waiting on. Nothing goes out without your OK. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

Tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.
Description: OpenFrame gives small IT teams two AI agents to handle the work that never ends. Mingo patches devices, fixes issues, and handles routine technical tasks, with every change approved by your admin. Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

7. ChatGPT Wallet

Tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
Description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s “dots” agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.
